source_reference: Catalog of Problematic Data Actions and Problems
name: Appropriation
description: Data is used in ways that exceed an individual's expectation or authorization, including situations where the individual would have expected more value or more control with fuller information.

source_reference: Catalog of Problematic Data Actions and Problems
name: Distortion
description: Inaccurate or misleadingly incomplete data is used or shared, potentially presenting individuals in an inaccurate, unflattering, or disparaging manner.

source_reference: Catalog of Problematic Data Actions and Problems
name: Induced Disclosure
description: Individuals feel compelled to provide information disproportionate to the purpose or outcome of the transaction, including where access to an essential service is leveraged.

source_reference: Catalog of Problematic Data Actions and Problems
name: Insecurity
description: Lapses in data security expose personal data to unauthorized access, misuse, or compromise.

source_reference: Catalog of Problematic Data Actions and Problems
name: Re-identification
description: Data previously de-identified or otherwise disassociated from individuals becomes identifiable again.

source_reference: Catalog of Problematic Data Actions and Problems
name: Stigmatization
description: Data is linked to an actual identity in a way that creates stigma and can contribute to dignity loss or discrimination.

source_reference: Catalog of Problematic Data Actions and Problems
name: Surveillance
description: Data, devices, or individuals are tracked or monitored in a manner disproportionate to the purpose.

source_reference: Catalog of Problematic Data Actions and Problems
name: Unanticipated Revelation
description: Data reveals or exposes an individual or attributes about an individual in unexpected ways, often through aggregation or analysis.

source_reference: Catalog of Problematic Data Actions and Problems
name: Unwarranted Restriction
description: Individuals are blocked from data or services, or their awareness of data and its uses is limited in ways disproportionate to operational purposes.

source_reference: Catalog of Problematic Data Actions and Problems
name: Dignity Loss
description: Embarrassment, humiliation, or emotional distress resulting from data processing.

source_reference: Catalog of Problematic Data Actions and Problems
name: Discrimination
description: Unfair or unethical differential treatment of individuals or groups arising from data processing.

source_reference: Catalog of Problematic Data Actions and Problems
name: Economic Loss
description: Direct or indirect financial harm, including identity theft-related loss or failure to receive fair value in a transaction.

source_reference: Catalog of Problematic Data Actions and Problems
name: Loss of Self Determination
description: Individuals lose meaningful ability to influence how their data is processed or how they interact with systems, products, or services.

source_reference: Catalog of Problematic Data Actions and Problems
name: Loss of Autonomy
description: Individuals lose control over information processing or modify ordinary behavior through self-restriction or chilling effects.

source_reference: Catalog of Problematic Data Actions and Problems
name: Loss of Liberty
description: Improper exposure or use of information contributes to detention, arrest, or other abuse of power affecting freedom.

source_reference: Catalog of Problematic Data Actions and Problems
name: Physical Harm
description: Data processing contributes to bodily injury, safety risk, or death.

source_reference: Catalog of Problematic Data Actions and Problems
name: Loss of Trust
description: Implicit or explicit expectations about data processing are breached, making individuals reluctant to continue engaging.
